title: Lisse integral lattices on a finite stratification
statement: Let ℓ be prime, E a finite-dimensional normed ℚ_ℓ-algebra which is a normed field, and X a scheme with noetherian underlying topological space. Use the continuous integral and rational coefficient rings and their inclusion of [def-weil-pbc-continuous-integral-coefficients]. Let P be an internal rational module on X which is pro-etale locally finite free in the sense of [def-weil-pbc-condensed-e-module-category]. There is a finite constructible locally closed stratification S of X [def-constructible-stratification]. On each domain S_a there is an internal constructible integral module M_a whose ordinary rational scalar extension is isomorphic to the canonical coefficient pullback of P to S_a. This supplies only the models of the strata; reconstructing P globally is not asserted. Ranks may vary or be zero and X may be empty.

proof.text: Choose a qcqs etale surjection U→X with a locally finite free integral lattice by the etale-local lattice theorem.

Apply the existing theorem that a qcqs etale morphism is finite etale after restriction to a finite locally closed constructible stratification. Its pullbacks remain surjective. Each stratum is topologically noetherian by its immersion into X.

Use the existing canonical PullbackSystem from ContinuousLissePullbackSystem and continuousLisse_coefficient_lattice_on_stratum from ContinuousLisseCoefficientDescent. The system constructs the actual integral and rational inverse-image functors and their scalar-change and composition isomorphisms. Its proved local-freeness fields base change the trivializing scheme cover and transport free-module presentations, giving the same local-freeness result as the reusable API. The stratum helper pulls back the lattice and rational module, uses the cartesian-square equality to identify their rationalizations, and applies finite etale descent.

Apply finite etale lattice descent on each stratum. A locally finite free integral module is locally finitely presented, using the zero relation module and the zero-cokernel isomorphism. The one-part identity stratification then proves constructibility.

proof_origin.note: C4: internal continuous coefficient interface; source argument below the proper-base-change unit. B2 return repair: local-freeness helper implementations moved to a common acyclic API without changing the public stratification theorem. F2 quarantine restoration (2026-10-21): restore the complete public theorem and its system-based proof; replace the withdrawn Sheaf.AlgebraicGeometry.EtaleStratifiedFinite proof import by the existing WeilConjectures.AlgebraicGeometry.EtaleStratifiedFinite attachment. Remove unused local locallyFree_lfp and locallyFree_constructible helpers and redundant direct proof imports. Their needed implementations remain in the imported pullback-system and stratum-descent modules. Mathematical dependencies and the public signature are preserved; no holes added.

lean.statement:
theorem continuousLisse_stratified_lattices
    (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime] (E : Type) [NormedField E]
    [NormedAlgebra ℚ_[ℓ] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[ℓ] E]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [TopologicalSpace.NoetherianSpace X]
    (P : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1})
      (condensedRingObj (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) X))
    (hP : ∃ C : Scheme.Cover.{u} Scheme.proetalePrecoverage X, ∀ s : C.I₀,
      Mod.IsFree ((ProEtale.upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (C.f s)).obj
        (condensedRingObj (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) X))
        (((ProEtale.upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (C.f s)).mapMod _).obj P)) :
    ∃ S : Scheme.Stratification X, ∀ s : Fin S.n,
      ∃ M : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology (S.domain s)) Ab.{u + 1})
          (condensedRingObj (integralCoeff ℓ E) (S.domain s)),
        ProEtale.IsConstructibleModuleObject
          (condensedRingObj (integralCoeff ℓ E) (S.domain s)) M ∧
        Nonempty ((Mod.extendScalars
          (coefficientMap (integralScalarMap ℓ E) (S.domain s))).obj M ≅
            (CondensedRing.upperStar (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E)
              (S.immersion s)).obj P)
